name: Grassrivers Swamp Creature
summary: Community researchers report sightings of a towering bipedal figure in Grassrivers swamp during heavy nocturnal fog. An apparent homage to Florida's legendary Skunk Ape lore.
description: Echoing the famous cryptid hunts of San Andreas and Mount Chiliad, Grassrivers features eerie reports of a heavy humanoid creature navigating dense cypress groves. Ambient audio cues and distorted footprints near remote bayou cabins fuel the mystery.
discoveryMethod: Trek through northeastern Grassrivers wetlands on foot between 1 AM and 4 AM during thick fog.
prerequisites: Dense fog weather condition during night hours.
evidence: Eerie low-frequency vocalizations and transient silhouette appearances observed at long range.
interpretation: Rockstar's satirical and atmospheric take on the Florida Everglades Skunk Ape legend.
